# Senior Cloud & Backend Engineer
**Company**: TechSolutions AB
**Location**: Gothenburg, Sweden (Hybrid)

## About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our core cloud platform team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable microservices and integrating AI features into our existing .NET ecosystem.

## Key Responsibilities
- Design and develop scalable backend APIs using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET.
- Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure using AWS (EC2, S3, RDS).
- Collaborate with the data science team to integrate RAG pipelines and LLMs into production.
- Containerize applications using Docker and orchestrate with Kubernetes.
- Optimize database queries and ensure high availability of services.

## Requirements
- 5+ years of experience in backend development using .NET/C#.
- Strong experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS or Azure.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with Python and AI/ML integrations is a strong plus.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for clean, maintainable code.
- Fluent in English. Swedish is a plus but not required.

## What We Offer
- Competitive salary and stock options.
- Flexible hybrid work model (2 days in the Gothenburg office, 3 days remote).
- Annual learning budget and opportunities to attend international conferences.
